name: Apollo 11 LM
about: Apollo 11 LM (1969-059C), a crewed vehicle (LM AS), launched 1969 Jul 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Jul 16), held fixed
